goal: Automatically compute header sync DoS parameters at startup instead of hardcoding them per release
Eliminates manual release preparation overhead and human estimation mistakes for maintainers
reviewability: Review is worthwhile now because the required rebase is mechanical
agreement: Strong support after reviewing the revised calculation from scratch (darosior)
Approach approval noting a rebase is needed (ajtowns)
Edge-case termination and integer overflow concerns resolved in updates (shuv-amp)
Concept approval without stated reasons (sedited, fjahr)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because peer DoS protection stays accurate over time instead of relying on lifetime guesses
Prevents node memory exhaustion and sync stalls against strategic low-difficulty header spam
